reviews.review: Best Military simulation out there, with a good MilSim community.

Arma 3 is the best military sandbox game around. Mainly because it's the only one... I wouldn't go so far to call this a realistic simulation at all. It's got some good things going for it that previous entries didn't have, but they're extremely overshadowed by insanely clunky, unoptimized, and frustrating gameplay. I have never seen such a worse game in those regards.

The foundation and concept of Arma is tried and true. Going way back to the Operation Flashpoint days, a lot of gameplay mechanics and ideas are almost identical today. Sure, previous entries were always clunky and maybe a little frustrating. They were also probably a bit unoptimized as well. However, we could give them a pass back then, they were limited by the technology of the time and still managed to pull off a massive scope of a concept. They produced an entirely new and original series that had a large following, and rightly so.

The problem with Arma 3 is that it doesn't seem to want to evolve for the better, ever since it released in 2013 and is still being "updated" in 2022. It [b] wants [/b] to stay clunky, unoptimized, and frustrating. It makes no attempt to improve in those areas. 

Worse, Arma 3 has less content than Arma 2 ever did, and even puts content behind a paywall with multiple pricy DLC's being released. Arma 2's DLC was expansions, which gave you some of everything. Maps, scenarios, vehicles, equipment/weapons, etc. Arma 3's DLC is mostly content packs, usually only giving you few specific unlocks in a category.

Finally, the gameplay is not much of an upgrade from Arma 2 either, in fact it seemed to have gotten worse in some areas. Ballistics in general feel very broken and randomized. Hit registration is slow and unpredictable. You need to dump half a magazine in an enemy before he goes down. He'll take minimum one full second to hit the floor with a horrid "ragdoll" animation where he awkwardly throws his hands up, slumps to the floor, and curls up; dislocating his spine as he sinks under the floor. You thought Bethesda was bad when it came to physics? Arma 3 is much worse. The UI sucks, infantry combat sucks, and vehicle combat is mediocre. The game Squad is the very opposite of what Arma 3 is. A literal night and day difference. If you're looking for a smooth, fluid, and modern experience, Squad is the way to go. It's combined arms gameplay feels much better in every regard when compared to this.

The only thing keeping Arma 3 on life support is the Steam Workshop mods. All Arma entries have had a fairly large modding community. However, previous entries never had Steam Workshop integration which makes this community much more larger and easily accessible. I hope Arma 4 is better, because this is not reflective of modern gaming. So much is wrong with this, and I think Bohemia Interactive full well knows this and chooses to do nothing about it. Of course, they'll release their DLC's though and allow the community to keep them alive via Steam Workshop.
